failure_summary: The assembled prompt REQUIRES [zone:better-col] ("# You MUST build the explanation around these", PROMPT line 70) and states the better move as "column 5" (line 3), yet no run of 5 emitted better-col and no run named the better column in compliant prose — runs 0/1/2 fail the pre-computed A6 outright, and runs 3/4 only pass because they wrote the forbidden raw coordinate c5r6 which stripInternalTokens humanised to "column 5, row 6"; production-fidelity caveat: with gpt-5.4-mini this cannot be separated from model capability.
notes: Sub-sampling per rubric: A3, A4, G2, G4, G5 graded on runs 0-1 only; runs 2-4 are null (not scored) for those axes. A6 copied verbatim from _served_mechanical.json (fail on 0/1/2, pass on 3/4) — intermittent. G1 fail on all 5 runs: the required handle [zone:better-col] from the prompt's "You MUST build the explanation around these" block is absent from every mechanism (all 5 emit only you-immediate + you-key-line); additionally runs 0/1/2 use the future-tense "threat to make four next move"/"next-move ... square"/"keeps ... alive" framing that the prompt explicitly forbids for a move that wins on the spot ("never future tense ... for a move that already ended the game"), and runs 3/4 write raw squares (c5r6, c4r6-c7r6) against "Never write a raw square". Board truth (visualize_board on 33333111155545355220244122462616660064): green to move, col 5 is gravity-top at c5r6 with solver score +2 (win); row 6 holds Y at c2,c3,c4,c6,c7 so c5r6 completes c4r6-c7r6 (and c2r6-c5r6); played col 1 lands c1r4, score 0 (draw), and render_decision.finalMovestring 3333311115554535522024412246261666006404 has the opponent occupying c5r6 at ply 40 — every cell/line named by every run is board-true, so A3/A4/G4 hold. G5/G6: afterBest board is a completed win with no tactics; L1 routing is correct. G7: annotationRepairs empty, guardDiagnostics clean, each handle wraps a shape-matching phrase (square words on you-immediate, line words on you-key-line, term adjacent not nested).

counterexamples.evidence: PROMPT:70 requires [zone:better-col] = "the column of the better move"; 0/5 runs emitted it. A6 passes only in runs 3-4, and only via the guard: raw mechanism says "the c5r6 square"/"c5r6", which stripInternalTokens rewrites to "column 5, row 6" before mentionsBetterColumn tests for the column word. No run names column 5 in prose the render would sanction.

PROMPT:35 renders "it wins on the spot, completing four in column 5" — board-false as written: column 5 holds O r5, Y r4, Y r3, O r2, Y r1, no vertical four; the four completes along row 6 (c4r6-c7r6). No run repeated the error, but the frame is a render defect.
